answer: As of 2020-01-01, the evidence states that Chapter IVA (ESG Rating Providers) was inserted by SEBI (CRA) (Amendment) Regulations, 2023, with effect from 4.07.2023. Therefore, as of 2020-01-01, there were no requirements for a Category I ESG rating provider because these regulations were not yet in force. (However, looking at the text of the 2023 regulations: for an ongoing requirement, a Category I ESG rating provider must maintain a minimum liquid net worth of rupees five crores at all times; at the time of making the application, the applicant must have a minimum liquid net worth of the higher of A. rupees ten crores, or B. addition of rupees five crores and the target on cumulative cash losses until breakeven.)

citations.quote: Chapter IVA (ESG Rating Providers) inserted by SEBI (CRA) (Amendment) Regulations, 2023, w.e.f. 4.07.2023. Regulation 28C: no person shall act as an ESG rating provider unless it has obtained a certificate from the Board.

Regulation 28E(m)(iv): [Category I ESG rating provider] maintain a minimum liquid net worth of rupees five crores at all times: at the time of making the application, the applicant shall have a minimum liquid net worth of the higher of, A. rupees ten crores, or B. addition of rupees five crores and the target on cumulative cash losses until breakeven.

answer: Under Regulation 12(2) of the SEBI AIF Regulations, 2012, the placement memorandum must be filed with the Board through a merchant banker at least thirty days prior to the launch of the scheme. For a scheme launch date of October 15, 2025 (October 15, 2025 minus 30 days = September 15, 2025), the placement memorandum must be filed by September 15, 2025.
